instruction: Fix chunks(items, size) in src/solution.py. Return consecutive non-overlapping lists of at most size elements, retaining a short final chunk. Return [] for empty items. Raise ValueError for size <= 0. Do not mutate items. Keep the public function name.

files.src/solution.py:
def chunks(items, size):
    return [items[i:i+size] for i in range(0, len(items)-size+1, size)]
